tooltips.isDefault: If checked, this funnel will be automatically selected for new opportunities within the team
tooltips.followupsEnabled: When on, the AI schedules follow-ups automatically on open opportunities in this funnel when waiting on the customer. When off, the AI escalates to a human task instead, while still allowing people to schedule a follow-up manually on a deal card or by @mentioning the AI in a private note. Turning it off cancels currently scheduled follow-ups on opportunities in this funnel.
tooltips.followupBreakoutLimit: Funnel-level default for the maximum number of consecutive AI follow-ups in a cycle before automated follow-up stops and escalates to a human task. Leave empty to default to 1 unless an opportunity has its own explicit Follow-up Breakout Limit.
